name: bi-etl-ejuice
description: Claude Code marketplace hosted in the bi-etl-ejuice repo. Distributes the BI/data-platform plugins (Tars and friends) maintained by the QuintoAndar data team.

plugins.name: tars
plugins.description: Technical Data Analyst for QuintoAndar's Trino data lake. Executes Trino SQL, persists full query results to disk, previews <=10 rows, and appends an auditable JSONL track record to the current project folder.
